# Modex

> Unofficial community desktop for Codex and Claude Code CLIs, with worktrees, approvals, parallel threads, and optional Jev routing. Not an official vendor application.

## Entry points

- [README](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/modex/blob/main/README.md)
- [Developer and agent guide](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/modex/blob/main/docs/discovery/README.md)
- [Repository instructions](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/modex/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/modex/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Auto-routing contract](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/modex/blob/main/docs/auto-routing.md)
- [Screenshot reproduction](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/modex/blob/main/docs/discovery/SCREENSHOTS.md)

## Boundaries

Use an isolated worktree and the repository's signing and CI requirements. Coding turns run through the CLIs; optional Jev routing is a separate feature. Do not weaken sandbox/approval behavior or launch live agents for documentation captures. This navigation is not execution authorization. Preserve source attribution and distinguish offline demonstrations from live results.
